title: View of Mission Control Center during the Apollo 13 oxygen cell failure
description: S70-34904 (14 April 1970) --- Astronaut Alan B. Shepard Jr., prime crew commander of the Apollo 14 mission, monitors communications between the Apollo 13 spacecraft and Mission Control Center.
